name: Completed Course, Then a Different Course in a Future Academic Year
description: SLD POSTs a learner onto ZSC00001 starting 2026-06-01 and already completing 2026-06-30, employer approves it. SLD then POSTs the same learner onto a different course, ZSC00002, starting 2027-09-01 with a one-month expected duration and no completion or withdrawal date — over a year later, in a later academic year — via the new-style route with academicYear=2627 explicitly appended to the query string. Employer approves ZSC00002 too. Exercises a large temporal gap and an academic-year boundary crossing between a learner's two short courses with the same provider.

steps.name: SLD Creates Short Course 1 (ZSC00001), Already Complete
SLD Creates Short Course 2 (ZSC00002) for the Same Learner, Starting Sep 2027 — new-style URI with academicYear=2627
